frames.name: Services
frames.notes: Four numbered blocks alternating image side, each: 64px numeral, underlined 36px title, 20px paragraph, and the service's feature bullets as 'small title' rows with a glowing brand dot. Ends with the shared final CTA card. Numbering is positional and generated, so reordering services in Filament renumbers them. Images come from Service.image (CMS), not from the frame. DEVIATIONS: numerals are set in Maneli in the frame — not licensed, so they fall back to the display stack at 64px; the hand-drawn flourishes (322:5207) and the 'Group 21' badge (315:4998, 'جایی که هویت مسیر می‌سازد') are not placed.

frames.name: Blog listing
frames.notes: Centred hero + filter pills, featured row (270:5253), then a 2-up row of 612 cards and two 3-up rows of 400 cards. Card counts are not pinned: the first two posts of a page render wide and the rest 3-up, so the rhythm survives any page size. DEVIATIONS: (a) pagination controls added — the frame has none but the listing is paginated server-side, so later pages would be unreachable; (b) the active pill is 17px in the frame vs 16px inactive, treated as a slip and both use the 16px body token; (c) the hero's small book doodle (299:7730) is not placed.

frames.name: Blog article
frames.notes: Centred title + 3 meta chips, 1248x624 cover, prose body, lead-magnet strip, related posts, final CTA. DEVIATION: the frame interleaves the lead magnet partway down the copy column (303:4455 at y=792); the body is one rich-text field, so splitting it there would mean parsing HTML — the strip is placed after the body instead. The date chip reuses the blog card's calendar export rather than composing the 10-fragment variant.

frames.name: Contact
frames.notes: Details card (423) + form card (801), then a 5-icon social row. Form field names match ContactSubmissionRequest 1:1 (brand_name, name, service_ids, phone, message + website / form_started_at traps) so no backend change was needed. `email` is in the request rules but absent from the frame and is not rendered. The services multi-select is a disclosure of checkboxes, not a native <select multiple>, which cannot be styled to the frame. The 'working with' icon is byte-identical to the Home KPI retention icon and is reused from there.

frames.name: Privacy policy
frames.notes: Title 48/Bold ink-50 + intro 20/Medium ink-200 in a 612 column, then 8 heading/body blocks on a 64px gap in the 1250 track. Body is the Page `content` rich text, so the blocks are authored in Filament — the frame's rhythm lives in .legal-prose (app.css). Frame copy still reads 'صحرا مارکتینگ' (Sahra), i.e. the legal text was not rebranded in Figma; the seeded copy must be.

deviations.what: Home renders no insights and no FAQ section.
deviations.why: Neither exists in the frame. HomeController still passes `posts` and `faqs`; Home.vue accepts them as typed props but does not render them. No controller change made.

deviations.what: Hero headline set with fluid clamp() type rather than fixed 48/64px.
deviations.why: The file ships 1440px frames only. The clamp maximum equals the Figma value exactly at 1440, so desktop is pixel-faithful and only narrower viewports scale down.

deviations.what: Peyda (the family named by every FA type variable) is replaced by Vazirmatn.
deviations.why: Peyda is not licensed for this project; Vazirmatn is the stack the brief specifies. NOTE: public/fonts/vazirmatn ships Regular/Medium/Bold only, but the hero headline is SemiBold (600) — Vazirmatn-SemiBold.woff2 needs adding or the browser will synthesise it.
